issue.description:
ADR-003's dirtiness contract states every committed semantic mutation advances the live event sequence. Open beads cover the four families the ADR named — public create_issue, dependency mutations, external-reference mutations, structured-data mutations — but no bead covers the residual public mutating paths: `bead label add/remove`, resource-key/resource-lock add and remove, and manifest-composed mutations. Enumerate every public mutating command, add a test asserting each advances the event sequence, and emit audit events for any that do not (with per-family tests), so automatic post-mutation publication and content dedup observe every mutation.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Sweep remaining public mutation paths for event-sequence advancement (labels, resource keys)

issue.description:
The shared checkout currently holds ten untracked `.beadrs-<id>-verify.*` and `.beadrs-<id>-committed.*` directories, so whichever verification/committed-tree comparison creates them leaks them on failure or interruption — contradicting the atomic-mutation guarantee in AGENTS.md and reproducing the known stray-`.beads`-workspace failure mode that poisons tempfile suites with ancestor-discovery UUID mismatches. Identify the creating operation, give it fail-safe trap-based cleanup (including on signal and early exit), add a test asserting no `.beadrs-*` residue remains in the checkout after both the success and failure paths, and remove the ten existing directories.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Reap leaked .beadrs-* scratch directories and lock the cleanup invariant with a test

issue.description:
Split child 1 of 4 of beadrs-0d3c14c2 (record the build SHA in pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md; grand-umbrella beadrs-30368e99). Read-only decision step: no file edits, no commits - the only write is this bead's notes.

Context: beadrs-e15b70fd (SHA-decision child, closed) recommended 63c2ee86ac1af9ae5b88c86c1a2231cddef3da19 (then origin/main tip) with local 753b519fee1619918f93c8e5560ff817648dc20b as fallback, deferring the final call to the record bead after lineage reconciliation. Local main and origin/main were diverged (ahead 100 / behind 99) at split time - re-check `git status -sb` first; state may have moved.

Steps:
1. Record current `git rev-parse HEAD`, `git rev-parse origin/main`, and ahead/behind counts in notes.
2. `git cat-file -e <sha>^{commit}` for each candidate; confirm the attempt-resolution feature exists at the chosen commit (`git show <sha>:Cargo.toml | grep attempt-resolution`).
3. Decide: prefer the SHA reachable from the reconciled main that is also the pushed canonical tip; if lineages are still diverged, state explicitly which SHA the record will name and why - child 2 reconciles the lineages.
4. Write the decision, the losing candidates, and a one-line rationale into notes - downstream children and beadrs-c54dcd5f (handoff) consume this note instead of re-deriving.

Acceptance:
- Notes contain one named SHA (full 40 chars) that passes git cat-file -e, with rationale
- Feature presence at that SHA confirmed from its Cargo.toml
- No working-tree files modified by this bead

Coordination: sibling beads beadrs-08f1d96e and beadrs-c0b03a33 (other chains off beadrs-30368e99) cover overlapping records; do NOT edit pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md here even if they did - this chain's write happens in child 3.
